rationale.A: 780 m of its 1.2 km in mixed traffic on Tehtaankatu with tram rails
rationale.B: Cuts Tehtaankatu to 350 m, then quiet Kapteeninkatu/Pietarinkatu
rationale.C: Same as B, one block over (Laivurinkatu); only 170 m on Tehtaankatu
rationale.D: 210 m Tehtaankatu tram plus 350 m mixed traffic on Merikatu before the shore path
rationale.E: Quiet Ullanlinna streets (Tarkk'ampujankatu, Neitsytpolku); no tram street, only 180 m on 30 km/h Pursimiehenkatu; two unsignalised crossings
rationale.F: Short Tehtaankatu stretch (170 m), then park and shore paths; some walking
rationale.G: Long shore path, but 320 m in traffic on tram street Telakkakatu, 3 lights and several unsignalised crossings
rationale.H: Same quiet streets as E with a jog via Korkeavuorenkatu and more walking; +4 min

notes: No lights on any route, so no fewest-lights card. E at about +1 min removes A's tram-street riding entirely.
